name: Raconteur Global Resources Limited
summary: Raconteur Global Resources Limited primarily engages in the international trade of minerals, encompassing both their export and import. The company further deals in waste materials and secondary products generated from the extraction or processing of various stone types. Established in 1985 and headquartered in Mumbai, India, the entity was previously known as Ganesh Films India Limited until it rebranded to its current name in December 2023. It operates as a subsidiary under Annaya Management Consultancy Private Limited.
